maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from auction fees and services on salvage and used vehicle sales, not repair or maintenance of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Sellers are insurers, fleets and dealers; buyers are dealers, dismantlers and individuals, all private payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding its own online auction platform and yards, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Insurers and sellers can move vehicles to rival auctions such as IAA; switching is feasible, though Copart's buyer network gives it some stickiness.

notes: Mission-critical is a close call because insurer relationships and buyer liquidity create some stickiness.
